@NativeType("struct EGLClientPixmapHI") public class EGLClientPixmapHI extends Struct<EGLClientPixmapHI> implements NativeResource
struct EGLClientPixmapHI {
    void * pData;
    EGLint iWidth;

    EGLint iStride;
}

      public EGLClientPixmapHI(ByteBuffer container)
